Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely and incorrectly interpreted “Prince Napoléon Bonaparte” as Napoleon I, stating that the style “Prince” is sometimes applied to him. This ignored the established titleholder “Prince Napoléon” (notably Napoléon Joseph Charles Paul Bonaparte, son of Jérôme Bonaparte). By pursuing Napoleon I’s father (Carlo Buonaparte) instead of identifying the actual “Prince Napoléon,” the Planner set the workflow on the wrong person, leading to an incorrect father and birthday being provided and omitting the correct answer (Jérôme Bonaparte’s birthday).
